title: Sign Extender
statement: Design an 8-bit sign extender that converts a signed 8-bit input into a 16-bit two’s complement output. The top 8 bits of the result must be copies of the input sign bit. The module is used in datapath code to widen signed values before arithmetic.
behavior: y[15:8] must be all 1s when a[7] is 1 and all 0s when a[7] is 0.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use sequential constructs or memory elements.
hint: Copy the sign bit across the upper bits.
